Synthetic spreadsheets for the table readers (`table_text::read_table`): an empty
first sheet, then a sheet with an empty row, a header and three invented
lexicon rows (a tab and a line break inside cells, a whole and a decimal
number, a date and a date with a time). `lexicon.xlsx` was written with openpyxl; `lexicon.ods` is the same
file converted by LibreOffice (`soffice --headless --convert-to ods`).
